en-US.home-subtitle: Creating pure, focused writing experience for everyone
en-US.notfound-subtitle: You were directed into an empty page
en-US.about-p1: There are already plenty of mature Markdown editors out there — iA Writer, Ulysses, Nomo, and so on. I've tried a lot of them.
en-US.about-p2: But none felt quite right. Each had its own shortcomings, and none gave me a setup I was truly comfortable with.
en-US.about-p3: Some are paid. Some have messy interfaces. Some are paid and Mac-only. Others are basically VS Code — or worse.
en-US.about-p4: iA Writer and Ulysses have decent design philosophies, but both are expensive. They're clearly built to make money.
en-US.about-p5: I have reasons not to pay, too. Ulysses doesn't feel clean enough, and it only supports the Apple ecosystem.
en-US.about-p6: iA Writer is even more extreme — it refuses UI animations and most customization options. That's going backwards, if you ask me.
en-US.about-p7: A few years ago, while searching for something on Bing, I stumbled upon Linho's blog (github.com/linho1219).
en-US.about-p8: He had built an app called Clear Writer, inspired by iA Writer. Clean interface, smooth experience — writing in it felt genuinely good.
en-US.about-p9: I wanted to build a Markdown editor like that — something that gives me a great writing experience.
en-US.about-p10: Writing doesn't really need a powerful tool. What it needs is an environment that doesn't distract you.
en-US.about-p11: That's why I built SilentWrite. And that's what SilentWrite aims to be.
en-US.about-p12: Built to be a writing app that:
en-US.about-li1: Is cross-platform with a solid web experience, including mobile
en-US.about-li2: Supports PWA, with good Safari support as a stand-in for iOS
en-US.about-li4: Keeps the UI minimal and clean — preferences are set up once at the start, then live in Settings (obsessive-detail-friendly)
en-US.about-li5: Offers backup on the web version
en-US.about-li6: Has an efficient, tidy file system with folders, files, and file passwords
en-US.about-li8: Sweats the details — cursor, scrollbar, selection, animations — all the way

zh-CN.home-subtitle: 为每一位写作者创造纯净、专注的写作体验
zh-CN.notfound-subtitle: 当前地址指向一个空页面
zh-CN.about-p1: 市面上已经有很多成熟的Markdown编辑器了，比如iA，Ulysses，Nomo之类的，我也用过很多
zh-CN.about-p2: 很多我都已经用过了，但是我觉得它们都有些各自的缺点，没有什么能让我非常舒服的解决方案
zh-CN.about-p3: 有的是付费，有的是界面不太行，有的是不仅付费还只支持Mac，有的约等于、甚至还不如VSCode
zh-CN.about-p4: 其中iA和Ulysses这两个付费方案设计理念还行，而且都蛮贵的，是奔着圈钱去的
zh-CN.about-p5: 不过我也有不付费的理由。Ulysses看起来不够简洁，而且只支持Apple生态；
zh-CN.about-p6: iA更刁，甚至拒绝加界面动画，以及大部分定制项，开倒车了属于是...
zh-CN.about-p7: 几年前无意中在Bing上面查问题的时候翻到Linho大佬的博客（github.com/linho1219）
zh-CN.about-p8: 他写了一个叫做Clear Writer的软件，仿制iA Writer，界面干净、体验流畅，写作体验相当优秀
zh-CN.about-p9: 我也想要写出一个这样的Markdown编辑器，给我自己一个很好的体验
zh-CN.about-p10: 其实写作，最需要的并不是很好很强大的工具，而是一个不易让人分心的环境
zh-CN.about-p11: 这是我写SilentWrite的原因，也是SilentWrite的目标
zh-CN.about-p12: 致力于实现一款这样的写作软件：
zh-CN.about-li1: 跨平台且支持网页端，对移动端提供良好体验
zh-CN.about-li2: 支持PWA，且对Safari提供良好支持，代替iOS端
zh-CN.about-li4: 界面精简干净，在初始设置的时候由用户选择偏好，之后放在设置里更改，设置满足强迫症需求
zh-CN.about-li6: 高效清爽的文件管理系统，支持文件夹、文件，支持文件密码
zh-CN.about-li8: 各种细节如光标、滚动条、选中区域、动画等，都实现到极致
